comment: 更新日志：手动维护，每次改版在最前面加一条。version 用日期（YYYY-MM-DD），/more 页的红点靠它判断有没有新内容。

items: 第一版上线：聚合 PNCP 未来 14 天内截止的政府招标，八个类别，中英双语，每半小时更新。
标题与一句话简介均为本站原创改写，不转载官方公告原文；每条附 PNCP 官方公告链接。
新增数据源：PNCP 已签合同与价格登记（Ata）两个切片、联邦采购平台 ComprasNet 开放数据，站点条目来源更全。
items_en: First release: government tenders closing within the next 14 days on PNCP, across eight categories, in Chinese and English, updated every 30 minutes.
Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words; no official notice text is republished, and every item links to its official PNCP notice.
New sources added: PNCP signed contracts and price registration (ata) slices, plus the ComprasNet federal open-data API.
entries.title: 第一版上线
